description: Source code for Bluetooth Audio Input Control Service (AICS) implementation in Zephyr OS, including characteristic read/write handlers, service registration, and control logic.

methods.name: write_description
methods.description: Handles writing to the description characteristic, updates internal description, and triggers notification callbacks.

methods.name: write_aics_control
methods.description: Handles control commands (gain, mute, mode) received via GATT write, updates internal state, and triggers notifications.

methods.name: aics_state_cfg_changed
methods.description: Callback for changes in AICS state characteristic configuration.

methods.name: read_aics_state
methods.description: Reads the current AICS state characteristic value.

methods.name: aics_input_status_cfg_changed
methods.description: Callback for input status characteristic configuration changes.

methods.name: aics_description_cfg_changed
methods.description: Callback for description characteristic configuration changes.

methods.name: aics_write
methods.description: Helper to invoke characteristic write handlers.

methods.name: aics_notify_str
methods.description: Returns string representation of notification type.

methods.name: notify
methods.description: Sends GATT notification for specified characteristic.

methods.name: notify_work_handler
methods.description: Work handler for processing queued notifications.

methods.name: value_changed
methods.description: Triggers notification for a specific characteristic.
